When 3rd shift arrived, we discovered several pallets of barrels blocking the emergency exit. One of the barrels was also cracked and leaking oil.


Our team immediately responded by containing and cleaning up the spill while clearing the area to ensure the emergency exit was unobstructed and safe for emergency egress.


Reminder to all supervisors: Please make it a priority to regularly walk your assigned areas and address potential safety hazards before they become bigger issues. This is especially important given the accidental activation of our fire alarm system just a couple of days ago. Had an actual emergency occurred, the blocked exit could have created a serious safety concern and potentially delayed a safe evacuation.


Let's stay proactive, maintain clear emergency exits, and ensure our work areas remain safe for everyone.
